subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI Avatar not displaying (broken image)

question: Should Control UI support remote `http(s)` avatars, or should remote avatar inputs remain unsupported for Control UI rendering and be rejected or diagnosed clearly?
rationale: The remaining fix changes browser network fetching, CSP, privacy expectations, and the public avatar configuration contract, so automation should not silently choose the policy.

options.title: Keep Control UI local/data-only
options.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and update CLI/docs/validation/UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

options.title: Add a same-origin remote-avatar proxy
options.body: Support remote avatars through a gateway-owned fetch/proxy/cache with strict image MIME, size, auth, caching, privacy, and failure-feedback behavior.

options.title: Allow direct remote image loads
options.body: Let the browser load configured remote avatar URLs directly, accepting the CSP and operator-browser privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Keep Control UI local/data-only
recommendation.body: Preserve the current CSP posture and update CLI/docs/validation/UI diagnostics so remote avatars are not presented as renderable in Control UI.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest available routing candidate for avatar route and CSP/security policy decisions from current and historical evidence.
